title: Accurate Diagnosis and Survival Prediction of Bladder Cancer Using Deep Learning on Histological Slides.
summary: Weakly supervised attention-MIL with ResNet50 features and autoencoder reduction distinguishes bladder cancer on slides and generates MIBC survival risk; internal TCGA and independent Renmin cohorts gave diagnostic external AUC .993 and prognostic external C-index .622. Retrospective with modest prognostic discrimination.
